summary.text: Bob Morris is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 84 who has represented the district since 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He owned and operated Healthkick Nutrition Centers.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Misti Meehan, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: Morris earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University.
His professional experience includes owning and operating Healthkick Nutrition Centers.
He took office in the Indiana House on November 3, 2010.
